mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Sell The Trend: which one is the best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: product research, store analysis, AI product pages and visual import. Sell The Trend is better if you mainly want to chase trending products and put together ad videos. To launch and run a store with competitor analysis, Copyfy wins; for trends and ad video, Sell The Trend stays solid.

mainEntity.name: Is Sell The Trend cheaper than Copyfy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, at entry level: Sell The Trend starts at 39,97$/month against 49€/month for Copyfy. But Sell The Trend is limited to trending product research, while Copyfy covers product research, competitor store analysis, AI listings and store generation. Add up the tools you need for the same result and the bill goes past 49€/month. The free trial runs 5 days, no credit card.

mainEntity.name: Which one has the best product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, no contest for competitor analysis. Its AI targets winning products directly and scans rival stores, whereas Sell The Trend mostly relies on historical sales data through its NEXUS engine. To understand what really works for others, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

mainEntity.name: Can Copyfy replace Sell The Trend?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, AI product pages and visual import to Shopify. Sell The Trend keeps the edge on native ad video creation and supplier integrations: if that's your core business, it complements Copyfy well.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial with all features, plus a 5-day free trial. Sell The Trend also offers a 7-day trial, but with limited features and a shorter 14-day guarantee. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see if the suite covers your need.
